blocks.explanation:
Top degree 4, bottom degree 3: improper. The bottom has \((x - 3)\) once and \((x + 2)\) twice.
We divide first, then use Cases I and II for the remainder.
Plan: expand the bottom, long division, identity, put \(x = 3\) and \(x = -2\), compare coefficients, recombine.
steps:
Given: \(\frac{2x^4}{(x - 3)(x + 2)^2}\)
To find: its partial fractions.
Method: Improper, so divide: fraction = quotient + remainder/denominator. Then resolve the proper part with one fraction for \((x - 3)\) and two for \((x + 2)^2\).

Expand the denominator
\[(x + 2)^2 = x^2 + 4x + 4\]
\[(x - 3)(x^2 + 4x + 4)\]
\[= x^3 + x^2 - 8x - 12\]
Why: Long division needs the divisor as a polynomial.

Long division of \(2x^4\) by \(x^3 + x^2 - 8x - 12\)
\[2x^4 \div x^3 = 2x\]
\[2x(\ldots) = 2x^4 + 2x^3 - 16x^2 - 24x\]
Subtract: \(-2x^3 + 16x^2 + 24x\)
\[-2x^3 \div x^3 = -2\]
\[-2(\ldots) = -2x^3 - 2x^2 + 16x + 24\]
Subtract: \(18x^2 + 8x - 24\)
Why: Stop when the remainder (degree 2) is below the divisor (degree 3). Quotient \(2x - 2\).

Write the form and the identity
\[\dfrac{18x^2 + 8x - 24}{(x - 3)(x + 2)^2}\]
\[= \dfrac{A}{x - 3} + \dfrac{B}{x + 2} + \dfrac{C}{(x + 2)^2}\]
\[18x^2 + 8x - 24 = A(x + 2)^2\]
\[+ B(x - 3)(x + 2) + C(x - 3) \quad (i)\]
Why: Multiply both sides by \((x - 3)(x + 2)^2\).

Compare coefficients for \(B\)
\[x^2:\ A + B = 18\]
\[B = \tfrac{450}{25} - \tfrac{162}{25} = \tfrac{288}{25}\]
Check the constant: \(4A - 6B - 3C\)
\[= \tfrac{648}{25} - \tfrac{1728}{25} + \tfrac{480}{25}\]
\[= -\tfrac{600}{25} = -24 \;\checkmark\]
Why: \(x^2\) terms on the right come from \(A(x + 2)^2\) and \(B(x - 3)(x + 2)\).

Write the answer
\[= 2x - 2 + \dfrac{162}{25(x - 3)}\]
\[+ \dfrac{288}{25(x + 2)} - \dfrac{32}{5(x + 2)^2}\]
Why: Quotient plus the three partial fractions.

Check: recombine the fractions
Over \(25(x - 3)(x + 2)^2\) the numerator of the proper part is
\[162(x^2 + 4x + 4) + 288(x^2 - x - 6)\]
\[- 160(x - 3)\]
\[= 450x^2 + 200x - 600\]
\[= 25(18x^2 + 8x - 24) \;\checkmark\]
And \((2x - 2)(x^3 + x^2 - 8x - 12)\)
\[+ 18x^2 + 8x - 24 = 2x^4 \;\checkmark\]
Why: \(\tfrac{32}{5} = \tfrac{160}{25}\). Quotient times divisor plus remainder gives \(2x^4\).
